Answer: C
Reason: Figure 1 shows a right-sided pneumothorax (indicated by arrows) with relatively clear lung parenchyma, while Figure 2 demonstrates significant new and dense opacification of the right lung. This evolution from a pneumothorax to extensive consolidation in a COVID-19 patient is most consistent with the progression of viral pneumonia leading to increased opacity density, rather than resolution or isolated vascular events.
